verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill: a SKILL.md folder plus local Python tools that an agent loads. It is not a hosted service with a UI and a parallel API, so UI-versus-API parity is a category error for this kind of product. The local gallery and command-line search are local tooling, not evidence of an API, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
